summary: Window title setting is implemented. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the title sequence "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and Control.title(title), which returns an unstyled Control wrapping one title control. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor; it returns True when written and False when not a terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title) once per control. CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only, mocked). Caveat: I did not run tests or Black, per instructions, so everything is verified by reading only. No commits were made.
